headline: PAGASA: Rainshowers and Thunderstorms Possible in Subic–Olongapo Today
seoTitle: Subic–Olongapo Weather September 16, 2026: Rainshowers Possible | FMB News
seoDescription: PAGASA’s September 16 outlook for the SBMA–Olongapo area shows partly cloudy to at times cloudy skies with rainshowers or thunderstorms, 25–31°C temperatures and a 60% chance of rain.
deck: The SBMA–Olongapo outlook calls for temperatures of about 25°C to 31°C and a 60% chance of rain, with localized thunderstorms capable of producing short periods of heavy rainfall.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: PAGASA’s selected-city outlook for Wednesday, September 16, shows partly cloudy to at times cloudy conditions with rainshowers or thunderstorms in the SBMA–Olongapo area.
Temperatures are forecast at roughly 25°C to 31°C, with a 60% chance of rain.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Localized thunderstorms can develop quickly and produce brief heavy rain, gusty winds and reduced visibility even when much of the surrounding area remains relatively fair.
Weather conditions can change during the day, so residents should rely on PAGASA’s latest bulletins for any significant update.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Short-duration heavy rainfall can still affect road conditions, drainage and outdoor activities in low-lying or flood-prone areas.
This is a service forecast, not a warning of a major weather emergency.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch PAGASA radar and local advisories for thunderstorm development, especially during periods of darkening skies, increasing winds or repeated rain over the same area.

sources.title: Weather Outlook for Selected Philippine Cities

verificationNotes: The original September 15 review item was updated to the September 16 forecast so FMB News would not publish stale service information after midnight.
The forecast is attributed directly to PAGASA and does not overstate thunderstorm risk as a severe-weather warning.
